summary: Full E2E of Rentals map feature (admin + public) completed. Admin: Google Places Autocomplete on 'Dirección' field returns suggestions, selecting one renders the mini preview map (rt-location-preview) with a turquoise pin immediately. Saving persists latitude/longitude in MongoDB and survives reload. Public ficha (/alquileres/reservar/{slug}) shows Ubicación section with dark map, turquoise pin #5FD6C0, 'Cómo llegar' link opening Google Maps with the correct coordinates, and the address as text. No Error Boundary across 3 desktop reloads + 2 mobile reloads (googleMapTheme race-condition fix confirmed). No mobile horizontal overflow at 390x844. Public listing (/alquileres) shows '1 propiedades encontradas' with lista/mapa toggle (rt-pub-view-toggle-lista/mapa); Ver en mapa renders Google Map with the turquoise pin; clicking the pin opens an InfoWindow with price/title/address and a 'Ver propiedad' button whose href is /alquileres/reservar/casa-de-prueba-costa-del-este-borrar-d79b0a (correct — alquileres detail page, NOT /web/{id}). Regression /web, /web map toggle and / (home) all render with no error boundary. Property A161 was reset to direccion='', latitude=null, longitude=null at the end (verified via GET).
